items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: This guy waited for the people, he was a porter or something on the train, and he made connections some kind of way, and that's the way it would come out. He would hire the band.

ctx.x: I have heard of excursions like say the Elks or something would hire a band when they go to a contention. Yeah, but no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. Nothing like that.
The railroad. This guy waited for the people, he was a porter or something on the train, and he made connections some kind of way, and that's the way it would come out. He would hire the band.
Yeah. And when you got to Chicago, how did you get these jobs at the Royal Rick, or how was that arranged?
